title: 3 days to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: Meet the startups before they hit mainstream
slides: TechCrunch Disrupt 2026: 3 days away, who's ready?
Thousands of startups, but only a few will matter
The breakout ones won't be the loudest booths
You can still grab early access before valuations spike
Pick one startup today, track it for six months
thread_text:
3 Days Out. Who's Ready?

TechCrunch Disrupt 2026 opens in 72 hours. Thousands of startups will pitch, but only a handful will still be relevant in six months.

The Loudest Booth Loses

The startups that break out rarely have the biggest signs. They're the ones with a product people actually use after the demo.

Early Access Is Closing

Valuations spike once the conference floor opens. The window to get in before the hype cycle reprices everything is measured in hours, not weeks.

The Six-Month Test

Pick one startup today and track it for six months. Most will pivot, fade, or get acquired. The ones that don't are the ones worth your attention.

Pick One Today

Open the Disrupt 2026 startup list, choose one company, and set a calendar reminder for six months. If you haven't done it, start there.
